query:
UPDATE drivers SET
                status = $3,
                status_reason = $4,
                status_changed_at = $5,
                is_available = is_available AND $3 = 'approved',
                updated_at = $5
            WHERE id = $1 AND status = $2
              AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR updated_at = $6)
            RETURNING user_id
